anti_requirement_inflation: Only literal original bullets are audited. Resolution.remaining historical broad lines are not new acceptance criteria.
No reboot, whole-app restart or all-provider policy matrix is added to the unqualified Android restart criterion.
No permanent-outage requirement is added. Stale ContentProviderClient DeadObjectException and public KmpFile lookup while unavailable are distinct observations.
No default-decoder/every-target cancellation is added to IO-021 C3; its accepted actual paused-decoder cancellation is reused.
IO-013 C6 asks for OS-purge documentation, which exists; it does not demand OS-purge execution.
IO-021 C5 asks for guidance test/sample, which exists; source guidance/sample coverage is not native misuse enforcement or heap evidence.
IO-018 C4 has accepted actual UIKit live-composition evidence; an unqualified criterion is not expanded to a new all-platform composition matrix.
IO-018 Apple public zero should be rejected before native launch; native unlimited selectionLimit=0 is not a request to open an invalid public Multiple(0).
Consumer BUILD-001/#1 is already closed. Remaining API/ABI/native/minimum/security/readiness/publishing gates stay independent and are not inserted into these literal issue bullets.
Earlier accepted executions are reused, not replayed or counted as fresh. No whole issue is eligible from these observations.
important_additive_coverage: IO3 newly covers IO-019 single-document/file:// regressions and IO-008 public sandbox-local file path; fixed Android grant/restart evidence remains accepted.
Existing documentation/sample evidence clears the OS-purge documentation and main-thread guidance/sample categories; it is not new runtime evidence.
